info.title: Spawnpoint API
info.description: Everything here needs a token from Settings, API tokens, sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". A token carries abilities, and it can never do more than its owner: an admin's token reaches every server, a viewer's token only the servers shared with them and only what the share allows.

get.summary: List the servers with their live state

200.description: The servers the token's owner may see.

detail.description: Why the server is in this state, when there is something to say.

mspt.description: Milliseconds per game tick; 50 or less is full speed.

401.description: No token, or a revoked one.

403.description: The token lacks the ability, or its owner may not do this on this server.

502.description: The Rust service on the host did not answer or refused.

post.description: Needs servers:manage and an admin owner. Takes the same fields as the web form; the answer has dns_error set when the server was made but its DNS record was refused.

delete.description: Needs servers:configure and the configure permission on the server. A modpack server shows its pack's picture again; "picture" in the answer is what is shown now, or null.

get.description: Connect to the address with a WebSocket. The server sends JSON frames: {"t":"log","d":"text"} for console output, {"t":"stats",...} with cpu, memory and mspt every second, {"t":"history","d":[...]} once with the last ten minutes, {"t":"players","d":{...}} when the player list is read, and {"t":"out","d":"text"} with the direct reply to a command, if there is one. Send a command as a plain text frame; its output arrives as log frames.

get.summary: Get addresses for uploading and downloading files of any size

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: The server's short name, the first label of its hostname: "survival" for survival.mc.example.com.

200.description: Two addresses that are valid for five minutes.

401.description: No token, or a revoked one.

403.description: The token lacks the ability, or its owner may not do this on this server.

502.description: The Rust service on the host did not answer or refused.

get.description: Needs files:read for the download address; the upload address is only in the answer for a token with files:write. Upload with PUT to the upload address plus "&path=<folder>&name=<file name>", with the file as the request body. Download with GET from the download address plus "&path=<file>".

get.summary: Show who the token belongs to and what it may do
get.description: Needs no ability. Returns the owner, their role and the token's abilities with retired names expanded.

patch.description: Needs profile:manage. Nothing else about the account can be changed through the API.

get.summary: List the choices the server forms offer
get.description: Needs servers:read. Server types, Minecraft and Java versions, difficulties, modes, and the nodes with their free memory.

post.summary: Stop every server that is running
post.description: Needs servers:power and an admin owner. A server that refuses does not stop the rest; its slug is in the failed list of the answer.

403.description: The token lacks servers:power, or its owner is not an admin

post.summary: Move a server to another node
post.description: Needs servers:manage and an admin owner. The move is queued; watch the server's state to see it finish.

422.description: Not enough memory is free on that node

post.summary: Add the server's DNS record again
post.description: Needs servers:manage and an admin owner. Only when Cloudflare is configured.

delete.summary: Stop the backup that is running
delete.description: Needs backups:create. What was written so far is thrown away.

put.summary: Set how many backups are kept and for how long

get.summary: Get the address a backup can be downloaded from
get.description: Needs backups:read. The address holds a token that is valid for five minutes.

post.description: Needs backups:restore. The node archives the current state first, so a restore can itself be undone.

post.summary: Lock a backup so retention never deletes it

delete.description: Needs backups:delete. This cannot be undone.

get.summary: List the worlds in the node's import folder
get.description: Needs backups:restore. These are the paths an import with source host accepts.

post.summary: Replace the world with an imported one
post.description: Needs backups:restore. From a zip in the server's own folder, or a world folder on the node.
Needs files:write and the files permission on the server.
Needs files:write and the files permission on the server.

get.summary: List the installed mods
get.description: Needs files:read and the files permission on the server. Only servers that run Fabric, Forge, NeoForge or a modpack have mods; others answer 404. The list is the server's mods folder; "target" is the loader and Minecraft version new mods must fit, or null when unknown.

project.description: The Modrinth project, or null for a file Modrinth does not know.

update.description: Whether a newer build for this server exists.

post.description: Needs files:write and the files permission on the server. Installs the newest build for the server from Modrinth, with the dependencies it requires. It loads on the next restart.

project.description: A Modrinth project id or slug.

201.description: Installed. "installed" names what was added; "missing" lists required mods that were not, which happens on CurseForge and FTB packs.

422.description: The mod has no build for this server, or the server's loader could not be determined

502.description: Modrinth or the node could not be reached

get.summary: Search mods that fit the server
get.description: Needs files:read and the files permission on the server. Only servers that run Fabric, Forge, NeoForge or a modpack have mods; others answer 404. Twenty results at a time, most downloaded first when there is no search text.

200.description: The mods, and whether there are more

422.description: The server's loader could not be determined

put.description: Needs files:write and the files permission on the server. Replaces the jar with the newest build for the server. The file is the jar's name in the mods folder.

422.description: Modrinth does not know this file

502.description: Modrinth or the node could not be reached

delete.description: Needs files:write and the files permission on the server. Deletes the jar. The mod stays loaded until the next restart.

get.summary: Download a whole log file
get.description: Needs logs:read and the logs permission on the server. Comes back as plain text, gzipped files unpacked.

get.summary: List the server's scheduled actions
get.description: Needs schedules:manage and the backups permission on the server.

post.description: Needs schedules:manage. A backup, restart, start, stop or console command, daily or on one weekday.

get.summary: List the hosts that run servers
get.description: Needs nodes:read and an admin owner. A node's token is never sent back.

403.description: The token lacks nodes:read, or its owner is not an admin

post.description: Needs nodes:manage and an admin owner. The answer holds the node's token; it is stored encrypted and can never be read again.

put.description: Needs nodes:manage and an admin owner. The local node's name and address come from the panel's environment and cannot be changed here.

delete.description: Needs nodes:manage and an admin owner. Only when no server runs on it.

422.description: Servers still run on it, or it is the local node

get.summary: List the users with their role and shares
get.description: Needs users:read and an admin owner.

post.description: Needs users:manage and an admin owner. Without a password the user is sent an invitation e-mail.

put.summary: Change a user's role and shares
put.description: Needs users:manage and an admin owner. Shares are given as a server id to a list of permissions.

422.description: Refused, for instance removing your own admin role

delete.description: Needs users:manage and an admin owner. Servers they created pass to the admin deleting them.

422.description: You cannot delete your own account here

get.summary: Read the panel settings
get.description: Needs settings:read and an admin owner. A saved secret is reported as a flag, never as its value.

put.description: Needs settings:manage and an admin owner. Only the settings in the request change; one that is left out keeps its value, and one sent as null is cleared. Leaving a secret empty keeps the saved one; remove_curseforge_key or remove_cloudflare_token deletes it.

200.description: The settings as they now are

get.summary: Read the activity log
get.description: Needs activity:read and an admin owner. Newest first, fifty at a time; add ?server= to filter by slug.

get.summary: List your own webhooks
get.description: Needs webhooks:manage. Only the host of each address is sent back; the rest is the secret.

post.description: Needs webhooks:manage. The address must be https on the public internet.

put.description: Needs webhooks:manage, and the webhook must be yours. Only is_active changes; to change the address, remove the webhook and add it again.

delete.description: Needs webhooks:manage, and the webhook must be yours.

post.description: Needs webhooks:manage. Answers with what the receiving service replied.

get.summary: Search modpacks
get.description: Needs modpacks:search. Modrinth, CurseForge or FTB, chosen with ?platform=.

get.summary: List the versions of a modpack

post.description: Needs no token. Answers with a code to show the person and a secret to keep. Show the code; they approve it in the panel.

429.description: More than 5 pairings started from this address in a minute

post.summary: Collect the token once the pairing is approved
post.description: Needs no token. Poll with the code and the secret, waiting the interval the pairing answer gave: 202 while it is pending, 200 with the token once approved. The pairing is gone after that.
